evidence_specs.exact_quote:
From charge neutrality:
N_a * x_p = N_d * x_n

xn (n-side depletion width): 9.572692185158561e-05
xp (p-side depletion width): 9.57269218515856e-07
Total depletion width: 9.668419107010147e-05
Charge neutrality check (N_a*xp - N_d*xn): -1.52587890625e-05

So: N_a * x_p = N_a * x_d * N_d / (N_a + N_d) = x_d * N_a * N_d / (N_a + N_d)
And: N_d * x_n = N_d * x_d * N_a / (N_a + N_d) = x_d * N_a * N_d / (N_a + N_d)
very small relative to the values (around 1e-05 to 1e-07)
The code executed successfully and produced reasonable depletion widths.

    xp = x_d * N_d / (N_a + N_d)
